changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE otp_outbox ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID NOT NULL, intent VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, recipient_name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, redis_status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (redis_status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'EXPIRED')), kafka_status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (kafka_status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT', 'EXPIRED')), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, next_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT ); CREATE INDEX otp_outbox_pending_idx ON otp_outbox (next_attempt_at, created_at) WHERE redis_status = 'PENDING' OR kafka_status = 'PENDING';
